plan.topic: Retatrutide 'what's confirmed': Phase 3 results are real, but it isn't approved anywhere, and Malaysia's Health Ministry seized RM341,000 of unapproved retatrutide (Nov 2, 2026)
plan.angle: Open: 'Is retatrutide approved? Not anywhere, as of Nov 5, 2026.' Fact 1: one Phase 3 result, with trial name, population, arm, placebo figure and timeframe. Use the peer-reviewed paper if one can be opened; otherwise label it 'company-reported, not yet peer-reviewed'. Fact 2: 'On Nov 2, 2026, Malaysia's Health Ministry told Parliament that 12 raids, from 2025 to September 2026, seized 697 units of unapproved retatrutide worth about RM341,000 (The Star).' Online 'research' products aren't the trial drug, and nobody knows what's in them. Lilly plans to file with the FDA in Q1 2027, and a plan to file isn't approval. Better route: ask a prescriber about approved options or a clinical trial. Then the Exp F line, 'Not personal advice' and the prescriber line, with a loop back to the opening question.
plan.why: Retatrutide 'what's confirmed' Shorts are a proven lead format (209–278 views), there are fresh signals from Nov 2–4, and it uses the week's one gray-market slot. | fact-check: The Malaysia framing as briefed is inaccurate. The Star (2 Nov 2026) and The Sun report that the Health Ministry told Parliament on Nov 2 that 12 raids from 2025 to September 2026 seized 697 units of unapproved retatrutide worth RM341,000. It was not a single seizure on Nov 2. Bernama's 'over RM400,000' figure includes Ozempic products, so don't mix the two numbers. Lilly's plan to file in Q1 2027 is confirmed (pharmaphorum, Lilly investor release). The plan requires a Phase 3 result 'copied from the peer-reviewed paper', but I couldn't confirm a peer-reviewed Phase 3 retatrutide publication. TRIUMPH-1 (2,339 adults with obesity or overweight plus a comorbidity, 80 weeks) was announced as topline results on 21 May 2026. If no peer-reviewed paper can be opened, label the result 'company-reported topline, not yet peer-reviewed'. TRIUMPH-1 is a no-diabetes population, and TRIUMPH-2 is the type 2 diabetes trial. Gray-market rules apply: no sellers, no vials, no doses, no access routes.

package.title: Retatrutide: What's Actually Confirmed? #shorts
package.description:
Retatrutide isn't approved anywhere as of Nov 5, 2026. Its Phase 3 TRIUMPH-4 results (adults with obesity or overweight and knee osteoarthritis) are company-reported and not yet peer-reviewed. On Nov 2, Malaysia's Health Minister told Parliament that 12 raids (2025 to Sept 2026) seized 697 units of unapproved retatrutide. Online "research" products aren't the trial drug.
#Retatrutide #GLP1 #TRIUMPH4 #ClinicalTrial
Sources:
TRIUMPH-4 (NCT05931367): https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05931367
The Star, 2 Nov 2026: https://www.thestar.com.my/news/nation/2026/11/02/health-ministry-seizes-rm341000-worth-of-weight-loss-drug-retatrutide-parliament-told
Not personal advice. Talk to your doctor or prescriber about whether it's right for you.

factcheck.summary:
I checked every factual claim, and each one matches a source I could reach.

- **TRIUMPH-4 (s3):** The Phase 3 trial enrolled 445 adults with overweight or obesity and knee osteoarthritis and ran for 68 weeks. On 12 mg, weight loss was 28.7% vs 2.1% on placebo, measured as if everyone stayed on treatment (Healio). Counting everyone who started, the figures were 23.7% vs 4.6%. Results so far are topline only and haven't been published in a peer-reviewed journal (Healio; my search found only the January 2026 design paper). ClinicalTrials.gov confirms NCT05931367 is Phase 3, enrolled 445 and finished on 14 Nov 2025.
- **Malaysia (s4):** 12 raids between 2025 and September 2026 seized 697 units of retatrutide. Parliament heard this on Mon 2 Nov 2026 (The Star).
- **Filing (s6):** AJMC (5 Aug 2026) says Lilly plans to submit its FDA application in Q1 2027 and that the drug is still investigational.
- **"Not anywhere" (s1):** This matches what I found as of November 2026, though the two cited sources only support it indirectly.

Framing is sound:
- The script says "if everyone stayed on treatment" rather than using the word "estimand".
- It labels the results "company-reported, not yet peer-reviewed".
- It says a plan to file isn't approval.
- It includes the required retatrutide line ("research" products aren't the trial drug).
- It sends viewers to approved options or clinical trials through a prescriber.
- The disclaimer and prescriber line are both spoken and shown on screen.

Three minor wording fixes are listed below.

issues.problem: The Star says the Health Minister, Datuk Seri Dr Dzulkefly Ahmad, gave the figures in a Q&A session. The Ministry did the seizures, but the Minister spoke to Parliament. This is a small attribution slip.
issues.fix: Here's the catch. On November second, Malaysia's Health Minister told Parliament that twelve raids, from twenty twenty-five to September twenty twenty-six, seized six hundred ninety-seven units of unapproved retatrutide.

issues.claim: 28.7% vs 2.1% placebo, if all stayed on treatment
issues.problem: Muted-viewer rule: the main caption doesn't name the drug, the dose or the timeframe (the list visual does, but the caption field is what feeds the subtitles and the stat card).
issues.fix: Retatrutide 12 mg, 68 wks: 28.7% vs 2.1% placebo, if all stayed on treatment

issues.claim: Not anywhere, as of November fifth, twenty twenty-six.
issues.problem: src4 (AJMC, August 2026) calls retatrutide investigational and unapproved, and src3 covers Malaysia only. Neither source states outright that it isn't approved in any country. The claim is accurate as of 2026-11-05 (no regulator has approved it, and filing is planned for Q1 2027), but the support is indirect.
issues.fix: Keep the narration and source_ids [src4, src3]. Add a note for downstream packaging: write 'not approved by the FDA or any other regulator as of Nov 5, 2026; Lilly plans to file in Q1 2027' rather than any stronger wording.
